page.overview:
Who is Mokk?

Mokk is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 and onwards.

He is a Dornian representative member of the Coalition of Planets.

Mokk is a large, powerfully built humanoid alien with a striking resemblance to a lion. His entire physique is heavily muscled and defined, including his large hands, each tipped with faint, claw-like nails. His body is covered in a pale, whitish-tan fur, which is especially prominent on his head. His mane-like fur flows long at the back and sides, complemented by a well-groomed, elongated beard on his chin. His eyes are distinct, featuring yellow irises set against black sclera and pupils, giving him a fierce and imposing presence.

Mokk wears layered, regal attire befitting his high rank within the Coalition. Draped over his shoulders is a tan cape that matches his kilt, both adding a sense of authority and tradition to his appearance. Beneath these, he wears form-fitting clothing in a striking combination of blue, black, and gold. His armor includes blue guards protecting his knees and lower legs, as well as gold-plated accents around his waist in the form of a detailed belt. Additional gold armor pieces adorn his wrists and shoulders, further emphasizing his status and readiness for battle.
